title: Jerome on Ruth 1:4
body: “Ruth the Moabitess fulfils the prophecy of Isaiah:--"Send thou a lamb, O Lord, as ruler of the land from the rock of the wilderness to the mount of the daughter of Zion.”
author: Jerome, Letter 53, to Paulinus

title: Gregory the Great on Ruth 1:20
body: “Therefore call me not Noemi, that is fair; but call me Mara, for I am full of bitterness (Ruth i.”
author: Gregory the Great, Letter
